milestone: Initial local-first revision PWA and gated deployment

UI/UX Reviewer.evidence: Reviewed onboarding, editor contrast, accessible form controls and answer focus. Rechecked source fixes and six passing Chromium browser cases. Responsive checks use 1280, 390 and 320 px widths.

QA Reviewer.evidence: Independently reproduced the import-boundary and missing-test release bugs. Verified the scheduler limit, clock-skew handling, required test tags and canonical cache URLs. The browser suite exercises CRUD, review, offline writes and local backups.

Security Reviewer.evidence: Inspected the least-privilege Drive scope, in-memory credentials, opt-in transfers, backup validation, CSP, service-worker cache boundary and isolated deploy job. Rechecked transport retry and release-gate fixes. External account configuration remains to be verified.

Performance Reviewer.evidence: Rechecked memoized subject grouping, session-scoped Drive version receipts and canonical precache entries. Independently measured 107,534 B gzip JS, 3,007 B gzip CSS and 376,293 B precache in the local-only build. The browser suite checks offline navigation and zero external startup calls.

findings.description: Focus initially skipped directly to the grading controls after reveal.
findings.evidence: Reveal with the keyboard and check the focused answer region and following tab stop in @review.
findings.fix: Focus the labelled answer region and keep grades next in tab order.

findings.description: Leaving Settings ends the current Drive connection. Returning requires reconnecting.
findings.evidence: Connect, visit another route and return. The connection state belongs to the Settings view.
findings.fix: The Settings copy explains session lifetime. Reassess whether to retain the token for the entire app session if reconnecting becomes a problem.

findings.description: The original input border measured 2.88:1 against the editor panel.
findings.evidence: Compare #5d7060 with #1c2820 using the WCAG relative luminance calculation.
findings.fix: Use #697d6d for an approximately 3.45:1 border contrast.

findings.description: A card imported at the maximum review count could invalidate the vault when graded.
findings.evidence: Reproduced by importing a count of 999,999,999, grading and reading a snapshot. Regression in tests/unit/vault.test.ts.
findings.fix: Saturate the counter at the validation limit. Validate clock skew on import only.

findings.description: Omitting a required browser test could leave the release eligible when the remaining checks passed.
findings.evidence: Independently reproduced with synthetic reports missing required tags. Regression in tests/unit/report.test.mjs.
findings.fix: Require the expected tags to appear with passing results.

findings.description: The Pages emulator redirected /index.html and Chrome rejected its cached response for a later navigation.
findings.evidence: The first Wrangler browser run returned net::ERR_FAILED for offline /library. The passing @offline regression now covers a deep link, writes, reloads and the offline privacy page.
findings.fix: Precache canonical Pages URLs and fail the cache install if an entry redirects.

findings.description: A lost upload response could leave an uncertain create and cause a duplicate on retry.
findings.evidence: The Drive regression drops a create response and returns 409 when the same upload ID is replayed.
findings.fix: Back off and retry using the same pre-generated ID and multipart payload.

findings.description: Repository-wide Cloudflare credentials could be used by workflows on other writable branches.
findings.evidence: Independently found by Security and QA. An alternate workflow could invoke Wrangler with the repository token.
findings.fix: Use a separate deployment job, the same-run tested artifact and branch-restricted environment secrets.

findings.description: Invalid review evidence could be treated like absent evidence on preview.
findings.evidence: The gate regression distinguishes missing evidence from corrupt or invalid JSON values.
findings.fix: Allow absent initial evidence for preview and fail closed on malformed input.

findings.description: The initial test tooling resolved critical Vitest and Tinypool audit entries.
findings.evidence: The initial npm audit reported two Critical entries. The updated tooling has zero High and Critical entries.
findings.fix: Upgrade Vite and Vitest and keep the full dependency audit in CI.

findings.description: The audit reports ten Moderate package entries associated with the minimatch glob amplification advisory.
findings.evidence: Run npm audit --json and inspect GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 and dependent entries. The affected packages are in the development lint tooling.
findings.fix: Upgrade affected tooling when its dependency ranges admit the patched minimatch major.

findings.description: Overview recalculated the card count by scanning the full list for every subject on render.
findings.evidence: In a representative 1,000-subject and 20,000-card fixture, the former loop required 20 million comparisons per render.
findings.fix: Group by subject in one memoized pass.

findings.description: Repeated unchanged sync downloaded every full device snapshot.
findings.evidence: The Drive regression now verifies a second unchanged sync in the same connection only lists metadata.
findings.fix: Remember merged Drive file versions for the current connection. A fresh connection still reads the bounded remote backups.
